SELECT A.INT_RATE_ID AS intRateId,
'' as rateName,
DATE_FORMAT(A.RELAESE_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') AS relaeseDate, DATE_FORMAT(A.EFF_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') AS effDate, A.INT_RATE*100 AS intRate,
'' AS quoCcy
FROM MST_INT_RATE_INFO A
WHERE 1=1
AND A.INT_RATE_ID like concat_ws('','%',#{intRateId},'%')
AND A.RELAESE_DATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{relaeseStartDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND A.RELAESE_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{relaeseEndDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND A.EFF_DATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{effStartDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND A.EFF_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{effEndDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
